summary: Full backend+frontend regression on Nexxy relationship-first rebrand. Backend: 5/5 pytest passing (root, POST/GET /api/leads, minimal payload, 422 on missing required, no ObjectId leakage). Frontend: All spec'd data-testids present (navbar, hero eyebrow/headline/highlight/subheadline/CTAs, dashboard-preview, trust-bar, relationship-chain, 4 pillar-cards, consistency-section, philosophy-section, platform-section w/ 3 blocks + testimonial, 3 pricing cards w/ '$2.60 a day' on Growth, About+manifesto teaser, contact-form, footer). Hero headline verified: 'Every Great Deal Begins With a Great Relationship.' Manifesto page loads at /manifesto with correct headline 'Build Relationships. Not Just Pipelines.' and CTA href='/#contact'. Anchor scroll /#pricing works. Contact form: empty submit triggers error message, valid submit triggers 'Thanks! ... in touch shortly' toast and POSTs lead to backend. No 'Made with Emergent' badge in HTML. Zero console errors on both / and /manifesto.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: POST /api/leads returns 200 by default; REST convention is 201 for resource creation.
Lead.email uses plain str — consider pydantic EmailStr to reject malformed leads.
No rate-limiting on public /api/leads — spam vector in production.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' when env unset — tighten for production.
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed leads created via backend tests and UI contact form
